items.desc: The dissident faction of Congress plans to complete the provincial conventions by December 4 before holding a parallel national convention in Kathmandu from December 7 to 9.

items.title: UN climate chief urges speed as COP31 confronts fossil fuel divide
items.desc: A UN report last month found the world is already on course to exceed ​the 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit) warming threshold, a limit scientists say should prevent the worst effects of climate change.

items.title: Madhesh chief minister quits ahead of confidence vote
items.desc: Krishna Prasad Yadav resigns during a provincial assembly meeting after two coalition partners withdraw their backing.

items.title: Tinkar residents bear the cost of Kathmandu’s border rhetoric
items.desc: Residents of Chhangru and Tinkar depend on India for travel, supplies and trade. Disputes over Lipulekh and Kalapani make that dependence increasingly difficult.

items.title: Nepal calls for mountain-focused climate action at COP31
items.desc: The delegation urges a dedicated programme on mountains and climate change, fairer access to climate finance and stronger support for countries facing climate-related losses.

items.title: Sundarpur bids farewell to crash victims in mass funeral
items.desc: Thirteen residents of the Sarlahi village were among 14 people killed in Thursday’s Makawanpur crash. Twelve bodies were cremated together on the banks of the Lakhandeha river late Friday.

items.title: US to resume flights after air traffic network failure sparks chaos
items.desc: A communications failure at air traffic control centres grounded flights nationwide for four hours, disrupting thousands of journeys and exposing vulnerabilities in the ageing US aviation system.

items.title: Nepal’s high-value exports rise 23.85 percent in first quarter

items.title: For Mamta Kafle’s family, a guilty verdict is not enough
